architectureDecisions.decision: Release refs remain single-sourced in config/release-channels.json; a standalone installer fetches and validates that file instead of duplicating refs.
Only the immutable production catalog base is cached per process; custom style files are reread and merged on every public load.
Studio request parsing produces a plain-object contract and typed 400/413 errors without destroying the loopback server connection.
Current product counts are executable truth checked by the static gate; historical evidence files are not rewritten.
Locale-specific route groups own html lang while shared metadata and SiteShell preserve one visual implementation.
Adoption measurement is local-first and opt-in; no tracker or business outcome is invented in this iteration.

findings.statement: The installer slice only required a mocked stdin path and could pass while the real public raw-GitHub command remained broken.
findings.impact: The primary activation defect could be falsely closed.
findings.remediation: Add an official remote pipe dry-run bound to the pushed commit before completion.

findings.statement: A generic latency target would overstate cross-hardware performance.
findings.impact: Performance acceptance could be flaky or misleading.
findings.remediation: Bind the sub-second target to three post-ready samples on the audited host and report it as host-specific evidence.

findings.statement: Locale route-group changes were not explicitly required to survive GitHub Pages packaging.
findings.impact: Local accessibility could be fixed while the deployed static route disappears.
findings.remediation: Require both normal and Pages-packaged builds to contain both locale routes.

findings.statement: Deployment wording could be read as guaranteeing external workflow success.
findings.impact: A pushed commit could be mislabeled fully deployed when Pages or macOS infrastructure fails.
findings.remediation: Require exact outcome readback and honest failure reporting for each external layer.

adjustments.reason: Post-cache measurement showed that repeated system font discovery, not catalog parsing, accounted for the remaining roughly 0.8 seconds of every bootstrap request.
adjustments.change: Cache the installed-font probe per process, keyed by platform, PATH, configured font directory and local font-directory metadata; return a fresh Map to callers.
adjustments.impact: Closes the already frozen Studio performance acceptance without changing product scope, public contracts or final-render authority. New system fonts may require a Studio restart unless a watched project font directory changes.

adjustments.reason: Real-browser verification showed that a clipboard write can remain pending, leaving the public install action without success or failure feedback.
adjustments.change: Bound the Clipboard API attempt, add a local legacy-copy fallback, expose localized success/failure states, and verify both the normal and timeout paths in a real browser.
adjustments.impact: Closes the frozen public-site journey acceptance without changing the install command, product scope, data handling or external services.
